question: What was India’s rank in the Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI), 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**96th**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI)** is an annual ranking of countries by their perceived levels of corruption, as determined by expert assessments and opinion surveys.
 
• In the **2024 Corruption Perceptions Index**, **India ranked 96th** globally, reflecting its position among 180 countries and territories.
 
• The CPI is published by **Transparency International**, a global civil society organization leading the fight against corruption.
 
• The CPI scores countries on a scale of **0 to 100**, where 0 indicates highly corrupt and 100 indicates very clean. India scored moderately on this index.
 
• India's ranking was influenced by factors such as **corruption in public sector institutions, lack of transparency in governance, and inefficiencies in the legal and judicial systems**.
